gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-lyd: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label sets each letter apart like a bead on a rod, with a high x-height above Noto Sans Lydian's gentle text. Over many lines the sans stays approachable, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mah: Heavy, with every Impact Label letter standing alone like a bead on a rod, the heading hits hard. And Noto Sans Mahajani follows in a modern voice, its tall lowercase and funnel-wide e carrying paragraphs smoothly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mal: Noto Sans Malayalam reads with a dense middle zone, the lowercase body of each line doing most of the work, and its s opens generously. Noto Sans Malayalam then sits under Impact Label's heavy, bead-like letters, giving the sans a quiet floor to stand on.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-man: Noto Sans Mandaic reads with lowercase rising close to its capitals and curvy, unclamped letters. Noto Sans Mandaic loosens up everything Impact Label clamps down, whose heavy, bead-like letters are the pair's loudest quality.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mar: Proud small letters, curves ending in clear daylight: that is Noto Sans Marchen. And Impact Label's heavy, separate letters sit above it like beads on a rod, loud where the body is quiet.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-may: Contemporary and professional, Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has tall-bodied small letters. Under Impact Label's heavy heading, its visibly gaping c keeps a long run of text open and easy to follow down the page.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-med: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads with lowercase that rises high and curves that turn in without any ink pooling. Noto Sans Medefaidrin keeps a longer stretch of text crisp and contemporary beneath Impact Label's heavy, commanding letters.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mee: Impact Label's letters each stand alone like beads on a rod, heavy and commanding. But Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, with round forms that gap like a cracked bangle and large lowercase eyes, keeps a long read modern.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-men: Impact Label sets heavy, commanding letters one by one, each like a bead on a rod. But Noto Sans Mende Kikakui does the quieter job, letting daylight through every curve while its tall lowercase keeps text clean.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mer: Noto Sans Meroitic reads approachably, with c openings you can see through and lowercase that fills the line almost like capitals. Over a longer passage it stays easygoing.
